body: Long Beach Workforce Innovation Network - Special Meeting
agenda_text:
LONG BEACH WORKFORCE
  INNOVATION NETWORK AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JUNE 11, 2026
  415 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  PORT OF LONG BEACH, MULTIPURPOSE ROOM, 9:00 AM

Weston LaBar, Chair  Kendra Madrid, Member
Karin Kuo, Vice Chair  Julie Poincenot, Member
Gloria Carter, Member  Roberto Ruiz, Member
Xochitl Cobarruvias, Member  Courtney Russell, Member
Tommy Faavae, Member  Mandara Savage, Member
John Fay, Member  Kevin Smith, Member
Ken Gomez, Member  Adey Tesfaye, Member
Robyn Gordon-Peterson, Member  Henry Thomas, Member
Ean Hall, Member

  SPECIAL MEETING

  Members of the public have the option to email public comments to
  Karla.Corona@longbeach.gov

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-55429  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Long Beach Workforce Innovation
  Network meeting of Thursday, April 2, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-55430  Recommendation to approve the removal of Member Madrid, who no longer meets
  the qualifications of their categorical seat due to change of employment, and who
  has accumulated three consecutive unexcused absences.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-55431  Recommendation to review plan options for the 2026 Youth Development Goals
  and, if appropriate, approve the 2026 Youth Development Goals Plan.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-55432  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Port of Long Beach
  regarding its collaboration with LBWIN on workforce development initiatives.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-55433  Recommendation to receive and file an update from the Business Engagement

   LONG BEACH WORKFORCE
  INNOVATION NETWORK AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JUNE 11, 2026
  415 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  PORT OF LONG BEACH, MULTIPURPOSE ROOM, 9:00 AM

  Team regarding worksite development, on-the-job training, job placement support,
  and rapid response to local layoff events.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  26-55434  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the programmatic activities,
  initiatives, and strategies providing access to Adult, Dislocated Worker, and Youth
  with employment, education, training, paid work experience, supportive services,
  and career pathway activities.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  26-55436  Recommendation to receive and file an update on Economic Development and
  Fiscal updates.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  26-55437  Recommendation to receive and file Chair’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

9.  26-55438  Recommendation to receive and file Executive Director’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Long Beach Workforce Innovation Network on non-agenda items. Each
speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 24 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact Workforce Development Board at (562) 570-3650.
